'''Scout Chief''' was the title of the leader of [[Kalikori village]]'s [[Scout/Legends|scout]] force on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. The village's inhabitants, the [[Pilgrims]], used the scouts' information to protect themselves against attacks by the native [[Flesh Raider]]s of the world. Around [[3643 BBY]], [[Moorint]] was the Scout Chief of the village during the [[Flesh Raider uprising]].
